item.name: Halo
item.effect: Adds a glowing avatar halo that displays your Ascension count.
item.restrictionOrNote: Only five Halos show on the avatar even when the Ascension count is higher. Owning every badge, including hidden ones, turns the Halos rainbow.
item.cardSummary: Halo is the cosmetic you earn every Ascension. Your count can keep rising, but only five Halos show, and a full badge set turns them rainbow.

item.name: Forever Purchase
item.effect: Grants one token that permanently unlocks a single eligible tycoon button and turns that button gold.
item.restrictionOrNote: Cannot be spent on Hill Expansion or The Staircase. Unused tokens sit beside the cash bar, and you can cancel if you click one by mistake. A Robux shop buy also exists, but listed prices conflict so this catalog does not pin a Robux cost. Community first-token target is Wormhole Development for a x42 global cash boost.
item.cardSummary: Forever Purchase is the token that locks one eligible tycoon button through later resets. It cannot hit Staircase or Hill Expansion buttons, and unused tokens wait on the cash bar.

item.name: x7.77 Cash
item.effect: Applies a permanent x7.77 boost to future cash earnings.
item.restrictionOrNote: Each extra Ascension multiplies this bonus again. Read it against the x3.33 price hike rather than as a raw x7.77 speed-up.
item.cardSummary: x7.77 Cash is the permanent income boost from each Ascension. It stays after later resets and compounds with every extra loop.

item.name: x3.33 Price
item.effect: Raises the cost of tycoon buttons by x3.33.
item.restrictionOrNote: The hike applies to tycoon buttons, including Staircase purchases. Paired with the cash boost, net progression is about x2.33 faster per Ascension.
item.cardSummary: x3.33 Price is the cost penalty that lands with every Ascension. Buttons get more expensive, but the cash boost still leaves a net speed-up of about x2.33.

item.name: Lounge Access
item.effect: Unlocks the Ascended Lounge and its Ascension leaderboard.
item.restrictionOrNote: Kept after later Ascensions. Teleport from the ground-floor road. The lounge has the leaderboard and four pillars with white Halos.
item.cardSummary: Lounge Access is the one-time area unlock from your first Ascension. Later loops keep the lounge, and you can teleport there from the ground-floor road.
